shared_elements: shallow low-relief / incised carving on dark coarse-grained stone
paired, bilaterally symmetrical elements about a central vertical axis
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow outlined relief motifs on dark, coarse stone, and both show bilaterally paired forms arranged about a vertical axis, with a distinct ring/disc motif appearing in each. But A is a flat panel densely packed with fine, continuous scrolling linework filling the whole field, while B is a three-dimensional sculpted head-and-torso whose few bold, widely spaced motifs float on an otherwise plain body, so the compositional logic and carving scale differ fundamentally.
